description: New migrations/015_session_shares.sql, additive style matching 006/012/014. CREATE TABLE session_shares: id TEXT PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text, slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL (random, NOT the session uuid — revocable without leaking session id; reuse src/lib/slug.ts uniqueSlug or random token), session_id TEXT REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL (share must survive session deletion — snapshot is self-contained), user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, messages JSONB NOT NULL (full turns incl rich citation objects {id,tradition,text_name,section,tier} like blog_posts.chunks_used — no live corpus JOIN on read), voice TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL, study_text_id TEXT, retrieval_scope JSONB NOT NULL (owner prefs snapshot: scopeMode+blocked/whitelisted traditions/texts), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Index on slug. ALTER sessions ADD scope_override JSONB (NULL = use live user prefs), ADD forked_from_share_id TEXT (provenance, no FK). Done: migration applies cleanly on dev DB; check DB-fill freeze rule before applying anywhere.
